text:
amelia: paging: automated alert just triggered — KV eviction rate x10, continuous-batching lagging, multiple tenants seeing 95th latency spikes. looks like a config churn after last deploy. ops-pager-bot: INC [kv-eviction-surge] severity: P1 — 10 tenants > 250ms 95p for token-gen, error rate +1.8%

ops-pager-bot: AUTOMATED NOTE: correlated with rollout `batching-config:v2` at 2137652000 by deploy-bot.

jia: oncall here — looking at metrics now. which customers impacted?

amelia: quick glance: traffic spike for cust-42, cust-omega, cust-edge. cust-42 shows sustained kv-evict/sec from 200 -> 2200.

michael: logs show frequent page-in timeouts and lots of KV miss churn. snippet: ```ERR kv_fetch: timeout=200ms key=prefix:session:* attempts=3````

amelia: rolling back batching-config for all not ideal. prefer per-cust hotfix first. can we isolate flag?

jia: we have a feature flag `batching.window.v2` with per-tenant override support. I can flip for specific tenants.

kevin: +1 for targeted overrides. which tenants first? start with highest error impact (cust-42, cust-omega).

amalie_typo: (typo; ignore)

sara: I can run a quick canary rollback to the previous config for cust-42. steps: patch flag -> observe 2 min windows -> escalate.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY RECORD: batching-config:v2 rolled at 2137652000 -> seed percent=100.

michael: also seeing batch growth: average batch size jumped from 6 -> 60 for many small seq lengths. that amplifies prefix cache misses.

amelia: action plan: 1) Jia toggle per-tenant override off for cust-42 and cust-omega. 2) Sara monitor 95p, error rate, eviction rate. 3) If improves, expand to cust-edge and then global rollback.

jia: executing per-tenant override now: `/ops/feature-toggle batching.window.v2 --tenant=cust-42 --value=legacy` -> returned `ok` (tx 0x8a3b).

ops-pager-bot: NOTE: feature toggle change detected for batching.window.v2 tenant=cust-42 by jia at 2137654270.

amelia: sara, what do you see?

sara: within 45s: cust-42 95p latency down from 312ms -> 86ms. evictions/sec down to ~60. error rate back to baseline. looks promising. :thumbsup:

michael: good signal. cust-omega next?

jia: toggling cust-omega now -> `/ops/feature-toggle batching.window.v2 --tenant=cust-omega --value=legacy` -> ok (tx 0x8a3f).

ops-pager-bot: NOTE: feature toggle change detected for batching.window.v2 tenant=cust-omega by jia at 2137654301.

amelia: sara, are you seeing improvement across the board?

sara: cust-omega 95p dropped 290 -> 72ms, evictions down big. cust-edge still noisy at 95p ~260ms. I suspect partial rollout left some shards on v2.

michael: checking routing: some region-shards still pulling the new kernel for batch sizing. hypothesis: sharded rollout mixed kernel + v2 batching causing cross-tenant cache thrash.

kevin: if shards are mixed we should avoid global toggle until we decouple. For now keep per-tenant overrides. Also open a follow-up with runtime to patch shard affinity.

amelia: agree. I'll attach a short incident note and begin handoff to SRE for follow-up in the postmortem. Meanwhile, expand overrides to cust-edge and a few more high-latency tenants.

jia: applying to cust-edge and cust-mini now. `/ops/feature-toggle batching.window.v2 --tenant=cust-edge --value=legacy` -> ok; `/ops/feature-toggle batching.window.v2 --tenant=cust-mini --value=legacy` -> ok.

ops-pager-bot: NOTE: toggles applied for cust-edge, cust-mini at 2137654335 by jia.

amelia: monitoring dashboard: overall platform 95p down by 40%, eviction rate halved. still small residual for low-traffic shards.

michael: recording small log sample showing recovered behaviour: ```INFO batching: window=legacy batch_sz ~6 kv_hits up 3.1x```. Will snapshot and attach to PM.

sara: propose next steps: (A) keep per-tenant overrides active for 1 hour, (B) revert global rollout of batching-config:v2 (set seed percent back to 0), (C) runtime to investigate shard inconsistency and kernel selection.

amelia: +1. Jia can you change rollout seed to 0? we don't want an automated re-roll later.

jia: running `/ops/rollout-set batching-config:v2 --seed-percent=0` -> returns `ok` (tx 0x8b01). deploy-bot: ROLLOUT UPDATED: seed_percent=0 by jia at 2137654360.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED NOTE: rollback not performed; future skews prevented.

kevin: creating SRE ticket: SRE-4521 "Investigate KV eviction amplification post-batching-config:v2" with links to logs/metrics and toggles applied. assigning to michael + runtime.

michael: ack. I'll capture kernel and shard mappings and see where mixing happened.

sara: closing live mitigation: per-tenant overrides in place, global rollout prevented. we'll keep monitoring for 45m then open incident postmortem.

amelia: handoff: I'm going off-call in 10m; jia will be primary for the next 2 hours. leave a note in incident channel and tag SRE ticket.

jia: ack. I'll add to incident doc: `https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/SRE-4521` and include timeline + toggles.

ops-pager-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated — impact reduced to <1 tenant at 2137654380. Severity de-escalated to P2.

amelia: thanks team. nice quick per-tenant mitigation — saved global rollback. follow-ups: runtime fix for mixed-shard kernel, add guard in rollout code to prevent kernel/config mixed-state, add alert for batch-size growth > x10. I'll start the postmortem template.

michael: will gather artifacts. sara — can you own the customer comms draft for cust-42 and cust-omega?

sara: on it. short note explaining brief degradation and targeted mitigation, ETA for follow-up.

amelia: thread closing, will convert to incident doc and ping folks. :pray:
